title: TrustLens AI Extraction Proposal (P4 AI-layer intermediate contract)
description: Phase 4 P4-WP3. The INTERMEDIATE, AI-LAYER contract for the UNTRUSTED extraction proposals a model may emit. It is NOT a promoted Phase-3 detection contract and NEVER enters Phase 3 directly: it carries only extraction-owned proposal data (candidate normalized observations + indicator observations), which the deterministic WP3 validator resolves against RuntimeKnowledge and grounds against the submitted input, and which WP4/WP5 later map to governed Observation/IndicatorObservation. additionalProperties:false at every object level STRUCTURALLY forbids any decision/confidence/score field (a recursive name-scan is defence in depth). The model authors NO provenance, NO config_ref, NO governed confidence and NO decision field — the deterministic adapter owns those. Structural vocabularies mirror observation.schema.json / indicator-observation.schema.json exactly; they are not re-invented here.

ai_extraction_version.description: Version of THIS AI-layer intermediate contract. const per revision (a bump is a governed change).

input_id.description: The single submission this extraction is about. Every observation.source_input_id and indicator.input_id MUST equal it (single-submission MVP; cross-request references are rejected).

observations.description: Candidate normalized-observation proposals. MAY be empty (a valid response may contain zero items).

indicators.description: Candidate indicator-observation proposals. MAY be empty.

observationProposal.description: An AI-proposed normalized observation. Span-anchored (start/end) for deterministic grounding; structural semantics use the governed observation vocabulary exactly. polarity/attribution/mood are REQUIRED so a proposal carries the full structural frame Phase-3 relies on for later mapping. No confidence/decision field exists (additionalProperties:false).

proposal_id.description: Locally-unique id within this response; indicator observation_refs point to it.

evidence_excerpt.description: OPTIONAL transient excerpt for grounding verification only: it must equal normalized_content[start:end] EXACTLY. It is discarded after verification and never persisted into governed output.

indicatorProposal.description: An AI-proposed indicator observation. indicator_id + polarity are resolved against RuntimeKnowledge (positive registry / negative library); observation_refs point to observationProposal.proposal_id values in the SAME response. No confidence/decision field exists.
